Inputs (all under `section`; nothing else is top-level): - section.settings.heading: string or null - section.settings.max_tiles: integer or null - section.blocks: array (possibly empty). Every block has `type` (string, e.g. "tile" or "promo") and `settings` with the keys `title` (string or null), `url` (string or null) and `layout` (string or null). Rules: 1. Tile limit: if max_tiles is null or less than 1, the limit is 4; otherwise the limit is max_tiles. 2. Iterate section.blocks in order. A block qualifies only if its type is exactly "tile" and its title, trimmed of leading/trailing whitespace, is non-empty (null counts as empty).
